name: Cologix Santa Clara SV1 Data Center

profile.research_note:
Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 88 (Cologix missing-address campaign): applied 2050 Martin Ave, Santa Clara, CA 95050, sourced from the operators own current data centers listing page, corroborated by a same street reverse geocode of this rows own coordinates at 1.0 confidence (ten address number difference, same block).

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This Cologix facility is part of the company Ashburn, Virginia or Silicon Valley, California footprint. Cologix own site states the company has been operational since December 2010 and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado, describing itself as North America leading network neutral interconnection and hyperscale edge data center company, with 45 plus facilities across 13 North American markets serving about 2,000 customers with access to 725 plus networks and 350 plus cloud service providers. Confirmed United States markets include Ashburn Virginia, Columbus Ohio, Dallas Texas, Des Moines Iowa, Jacksonville and Lakeland Florida, Minneapolis Minnesota, New Jersey, and Silicon Valley California, where the company SV1 facility was acquired from vXchnge in 2021. Cologix grew through a series of acquisitions beginning in 2010, including Navisite, The Minnesota Gateway, Canix, MetroOptic in 2019, vXchnge in 2020 to 2021, and Cyxtera in 2023, the last of which connects to the separate Cyxtera operator record elsewhere in this registry. No building specific address or individual MW figures for this particular registry row were located in available sourcing this session. This session found the operators own current data centers listing page states this facility address as 2050 Martin Ave, Santa Clara, California, describing SV1 as the companys Silicon Valley hub for modern workloads. Reverse geocoding this rows own stored coordinates through a third party service independently returned a closely matching but not identical address on the same street, 2040 Martin Ave, Santa Clara, CA 95050, at maximum 1.0 confidence, a ten address number difference consistent with an adjacent building on the same short block rather than a mismatch. Given the operators own direct published address plus a same street, high confidence independent geocode of this rows own coordinates, this session applies the operators own published address, 2050 Martin Ave, Santa Clara, CA 95050, with the postal code carried over from the adjacent address geocode result rather than independently confirmed for this exact street number.

reading.body:
Cologix SV1 in Santa Clara does not publish its power capacity, so its size relative to other Bay Area facilities cannot be determined from the operator's specifications. The facility is located in Santa Clara County, where 103 data centers have been mapped but only 11 publish capacity figures totaling 365 MW.

The campus serves as Cologix's stated hub for modern workloads in Silicon Valley and is part of a 45-facility North American footprint acquired through multiple purchases including vXchnge in 2021. No certifications, tenant mix, or power specifications are published for this site.

Without published capacity figures, this facility cannot be ranked among California's infrastructure by size or assessed for its contribution to regional AI scaling constraints. The state context shows that California data center operators rarely disclose power specifications to the public.
